
```{r setup}
xfun::pkg_attach(c("tidyverse", "magrittr", "xml2", "sf", "scales", "ggiraph"))
gh <- "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jfronc/volbycz/main/"
source(paste0(gh, "utils/bubble_map.R"))
source(paste0(gh, "senate/create_senate_map.R"))

yr <- 2026

cache <- paste0("senat/", yr, "/data.rds") |> here::here() |> readRDS()

district_data <- cache$election %>% filter(so_id == params$so_id)
if (nrow(district_data) == 0) {
  stop("FATAL: district_data has 0 rows!")
}

maps <- create_senate_map(
  target_so_id = params$so_id,
  district_data      = district_data,
  municipality_cache = cache$municipalities,
  quarter_cache      = cache$quarters
)
```

```{r maps}
htmltools::tagList(
  htmltools::div(style = "margin-bottom: 2rem;", maps$r1),
  if (!is.null(maps$r2)) htmltools::div(maps$r2),
  htmltools::div(style = "margin-bottom: 2rem;"),
)
```

 link_next <- paste0("https://volby.jfronc.cz/senat/", yr, "/so", params$so_id + 3) 
 cat(paste0("[Následující obvod &gt;](", link_next, ")\n"))
}
